# S28 — Free-text recommendation with ask --recommend-text

`adj ask` can recommend only one of the option labels (docs/json.md: the
recommendation `label` is one of the option labels). During S17, C26 had to
gain a fourth option just to carry its recommendation.

**Findings:** S17 dogfood friction (4), note on S20; C167 · **Size:** M · **Trees:** model, cli, commands, render, lint
Cites: C165 decision: Release 0.1.0: an annotated v0.1.0 tag on local main; no remote, no push, C167 decision: A free-text recommendation: ask --recommend-text, C163 decision: S25 a stale copy must also hold the same record: IsStaleCopy compares the content, so a live record that shares the ID and name text with a moved one is not flagged, C172 decision: S28: a free-text recommendation is the recommendation's text key; label and text are exclusive, C173 decision: S28: --recommend-text is kept as typed and shown on the Recommendation line, C174 decision: S28: the agent snippet names --recommend-text in one sentence
